name: Teshimizu Kurara
source: Ayame's classmate and her class representative. As the gifted child of an upper-class family, Kurara has taken a special classical ballet class from a very young age. Though uncommon in most high schools, she is the member of the ballet club and participates in a national dance contest, Minazuki Academy has gotten extraordinary marks every year. Though she has an easy-going personality, she has a surprisingly firm foundation. She is Ryuji Shimazaki's childhood friend.
translation: 绫目的同班同学兼班级委员。她出身上流家庭，是个天才，从很小就开始接受特殊的古典芭蕾训练。她是普通高中里少见的芭蕾部成员，还参加全国舞蹈比赛；水无月学园每年都能取得优异成绩。她性格随和，却有着令人意外的坚实基础。她是龙司·岛崎的青梅竹马。
